import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t); s=np.sqrt(t); l=np.log(t)
cands={'s':s,'l':l,'t':t,'t2':t*t,'P':P,'P2':P*P,'P3':P**3,'tP':t*P,'sP':s*P,'lP':l*P,'tP2':t*P*P,'sP2':s*P*P,'lP2':l*P*P,'1/P':1/P,'lnP':np.log(P),'sqrtP':np.sqrt(P),'PlnP':P*np.log(P),'t/P':t/P,'s/P':s/P,'P/t':P/t}
import itertools
res=[]
keys=list(cands)
for k in [3,4]:
  for comb in itertools.combinations(keys,k):
    A=np.column_stack([one]+[cands[c] for c in comb])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    nm=np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    res.append((nm,comb,np.round(c,3)))
res.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
